about: Data tiers (9.26): folders the hub reads but never writes, most of them produced by lane B. Records and job keys name their files as tier://<name>/<path>, never by absolute path. root is relative to the repo root unless absolute; configs/local.json can move a root on one machine with {"tiers": {"<name>": {"root": "D:/..."}}}. A tier is missing when its root is absent, partial when its manifest or index is absent or its handshake does not say done, and present otherwise; a missing or partial tier shows as a status chip and a map layer's available() reason, never as an error. required tiers make crhub doctor fail when missing. mount tiers are served read-only at /api/v1/data/<name>/<path>.

tiers.name: ground_1912_real
tiers.about: The 1912 city survey rebuilt as a real-timeline ground surface, with its confidence and cover rasters, contours and fit report (ground/1912/SPEC.md). Consumers act only once STATUS.json says done.

tiers.name: ground_2026
tiers.about: The 2026 ground (map3 profile DEM in decimetres, with its water mask), the base the compositor fills gaps from.

tiers.name: sanborn_tiles_22
tiers.about: The Sanborn 1922 tiles (512 px at 0.25 m, EPSG:26916 corners in index.json) and their overview, for the map's Sanborn layer.

tiers.name: deck
tiers.about: The Deck site's files: deck.json, basin.json, plots, structures, relief overview and the other tile sets. Read for the map's relief and context layers and, later, the import:deck base sets.

tiers.name: old_hub_seed
tiers.about: The old hub's seed (alignments, chronology, data, deck, params, roadmap), the source of the legacy:old_hub layer. Read from git, never from the live hub/hub.db.

tiers.name: profile_lines
tiers.about: data/profile: the Metro line files (lines/*.json, Deck-tie output), settings and station tables, the source of the import:profiles layer. Each import run records the sha256 of every file it read (9.27).

tiers.name: artifacts_3d
tiers.about: The 3D artifacts from the project (Ben, 22 Nov 2026: "the 3D view will hopefully and eventually be able to include" them), kept beside the repo in _Cincinnati Rail/3D_Artifacts. Read only; the station workspace and 3D view (checklist 2.5.4, 2.5.5) will load them. On a machine where the folder sits elsewhere, set its root in configs/local.json. Declared from the project folder (root '..', index the 3D_Artifacts folder) and not mounted, until the 3D view defines a manifest of what it loads and the tier moves to the folder itself.
